  domain: string
  q: string
  options: [string, string, string, string]

  why: string
}

    q: 'A task always runs the same fixed steps: extract fields, translate, then summarize. Which design fits best?',

      'An orchestrator that spawns a subagent per field',
      'One very long prompt with all steps and a high temperature',

    answer: 0,
    why: 'Anthropic advises using the simplest pattern that works. Steps that are fixed and known ahead of time suit a predefined workflow. Agents are for open-ended paths you cannot hard-code.',
